Somos oportunidad y talento, una empresa de Ingeniería dedicada a ofrecer servicios de diseño, Ingeniería de Proyectos, Outsourcing y Formación. Buscamos un/a responsable de Proyectos Mecánicos para liderar la disciplina mecánica en proyectos internacionales de EDAR, IDAM y ETAP, con foco en la selección, instalación y puesta en marcha de equipos mecánicos rotativos y sistemas asociados. El puesto se desarrollará en un entorno multidisciplinar. ________________________________________ Responsabilidades • Dirigir la planificación, coordinación y ejecución de la parte mecánica de proyectos de agua y saneamiento a nivel internacional. • Elaborar y revisar especificaciones técnicas, pliegos y hojas de datos de equipos mecánicos (bombas, soplantes, agitadores, compresores, válvulas, filtros, equipos de mezcla y aireación). • Posibilidad de coordinar la instalación, montaje y puesta en marcha de equipos mecánicos rotativos y estáticos en obra. • Supervisar el diseño mecánico de tuberías, soportes, sistemas de bombeo y elementos de conexión. • Colaborar con equipos de proceso, hidráulica, civil y electricidad en el diseño integral del proyecto. • Negociar y gestionar ofertas con fabricantes y suministradores internacionales de equipos mecánicos. • Asegurar el cumplimiento de plazos, costes, calidad y estándares de seguridad. • Apoyar a desarrollo de negocio en la definición técnica de ofertas y licitaciones internacionales. ________________________________________ Requisitos • Formación: Ingeniería Mecánica, Electromecánica o Industrial. • Experiencia: o Mínimo 8–10 años en proyectos mecánicos aplicados a EDAR, IDAM y/o ETAP. o Experiencia en proyectos internacionales bajo contratos EPC/llave en mano. o Familiaridad con normativas y estándares internacionales (ISO, ASME, API, AWWA, FIDIC). • Conocimientos técnicos: o Selección, diseño y supervisión de equipos mecánicos rotativos (bombas, soplantes, compresores, agitadores) y equipos estáticos asociados. • Idiomas: o Inglés fluido (oral y escrito, indispensable). Valorable francés o árabe. • Competencias clave: o Liderazgo y gestión de equipos multidisciplinares. o Capacidad de negociación con proveedores internacionales. o Orientación a resultados, adaptabilidad y visión estratégica. ________________________________________ Se valorará • Experiencia en puesta en marcha y operación inicial de equipos mecánicos en plantas de tratamiento y desalación. • Colaboración previa en proyectos financiados por organismos multilaterales (Banco Mundial, Banco Africano de Desarrollo, IFC). • Red de contactos con fabricantes y proveedores de equipos mecánicos para el sector agua. Diseño mecánico de tuberías, soportes y estructuras. • Software: AutoCAD Plant 3D, BIM, SolidWorks, Caesar II (para stress analysis) u otros equivalentes. • Conocimiento para la integración de sistemas eléctricos, cuadros de baja y media tensión, instrumentación y control (PLC, SCADA, telemetría). ________________________________________ Lo que ofrecemos • Incorporación a una empresa global especializada en agua y saneamiento, con matriz en España. • Oportunidad de liderar proyectos internacionales de gran impacto en la disciplina mecánica. • Entorno de trabajo técnico, dinámico y multidisciplinar. • Paquete retributivo competitivo y acorde a la experiencia y resultados.

review_candidates.title: Python Architect (Data Product) IRC301942
review_candidates.description: Description Automotive industries Requirements About the role You own the target architecture and the design decisions for an AWS data-mesh / lakehouse platform, and you are the technical authority whose sign-off a release depends on. You set the patterns the whole engineering team builds against and guarantee the platform scales to large historical loads and a growing number of data domains. GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a leader in digital engineering. We help brands across industries design and build innovative products, platforms, and digital experiences. On this engagement you will join a senior team delivering a large-scale cloud data-platform program for an enterprise client in the automotive sector — migrating and stabilizing an AWS-based data lakehouse under a fixed delivery timeline. Job responsibilities Key Responsibilities Own the end-to-end target architecture: medallion layering (raw → trusted → shared), data-product boundaries, and cross-account data sharing. Make and document the design decisions: partitioning strategy, Apache Iceberg table design (branching, rollback, maintenance), surrogate-key / CDC modeling. Sign off on scalability and performance for large historical-data migrations and new data domains. Define the infrastructure-as-code patterns (Pulumi) and review that engineering conforms to them. Act as design authority across ingestion, fact/dimensional, and quality layers; unblock the senior engineers. Contribute to the work-breakdown baseline and to release-readiness and quality-gate design. Must-have Skills 8+ years in data engineering / architecture, with 3+ in a lead or principal architect role. Deep AWS data-platform expertise: Glue (Spark), S3, Athena, Lake Formation, Step Functions, Lambda. Apache Iceberg internals — partitioning, branching, snapshot/rollback, table maintenance. Dimensional modeling at scale: fact/dimension design, surrogate & hash keys, change-data-capture / historization. Infrastructure-as-code with Pulumi (Python) — or strong Terraform/CDK with proven fast ramp to Pulumi. Proven scalability & performance design for high-volume batch data platforms. Ability to hold decision authority and communicate design to both engineers and business stakeholders. Nice to have Experience with internal data-mesh IaC / fluent frameworks built on Pulumi. Databricks / Unity Catalog exposure. Automotive or invoice/financial data domains. Aurora PostgreSQL; Kong / API Gateway front-door patterns. What we offer Empowering Projects: With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As a team, we engineer digital products that positively impact people’s lives. Empowering Growth: We foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Our dedication is to provide timely and comprehensive assistance for every consultant through our dedicated Learning & Development team, ensuring their continuous growth and success. DE&I Matters: At GlobalLogic, we deeply value and embrace diversity . We are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, fostering an inclusive and empowering work environment. Career Development: Our corporate culture places a strong emphasis on career development, offering abundant opportunities for growth. Regular interactions with our teams ensure their engagement, motivation, and recognition. We empower our team members to pursue their career goals with confidence and enthusiasm. Comprehensive Benefits: In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment. Flexible Opportunities: At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company. About GlobalLogic GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

review_candidates.title: Projects Director - Build Egypt
review_candidates.description: Role Purpose Responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, and successful delivery of a portfolio of construction projects. The role ensures that projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards, while aligning with the organization’s strategic objectives. The Projects Director provides senior-level oversight across all phases of project delivery, leads and mentors project teams, manages key client and stakeholder relationships, and ensures effective risk, financial, and performance management across the portfolio Key Accountabilities Provide strategic leadership for the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple projects across the organization. Contribute to business planning, forecasting, and resource planning at portfolio level. Oversee all phases of project delivery from mobilization to completion and handover. Monitor project progress, cost, quality, and schedule performance, ensuring corrective actions are implemented where required. Ensure construction standards, methodologies, and best practices are consistently applied across projects. Oversee project budgets, cash flow, cost control, and financial reporting across the project portfolio. Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks to avoid delays, claims, or cost overruns. Support commercial and contractual decision-making in collaboration with Contracts and Commercial teams. Lead, mentor, and develop Senior Project Managers, Project Managers, and senior project staff. Act as a senior point of contact for key clients, consultants, and external stakeholders. Ensure projects operate in accordance with Health, Safety, Security, Environment, and Sustainability (HSSE) policies and procedures Qualifications, Experience, Knowledge & Skills Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred). Minimum 15–20 years of experience in construction projects, managing large, complex, multi-project portfolios. Strong commercial, contractual, and financial management experience. Experience working in EPC / large contractor environments is mandatory.
